latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the CreditClaw financial enablement & accounting platform for bots and AI agents.

- Provides multi-rail agent spending: prepaid wallets, self-hosted cards, and Stripe/USDC rails
- Secure, consolidated account management across agents with real-time guardrails and human approval
- Full API reference and registration flows, including bot self-registration and owner pairing
- Detailed documentation on setup, security, and best practices for key management
- Live, per-endpoint rate limits, webhook support, and granular spend controls enforced server-side
- No owner payment data ever stored; all payment collection handled via Stripe
